niche: online spiritual and shadow work courses
prompt_text: What are the best online courses for learning shadow work and spiritual practice?
answer_verbatim:
Here are some solid options across different formats:

**Structured courses:**
- Udemy and Coursera have affordable psychology-based courses on shadow work (often $10-15 on sale)
- Insight Timer offers free and paid meditation/spiritual courses
- Masterclass has some well-regarded teachers, though pricier

**Specialized platforms:**
- Gaia (subscription model, focuses on spirituality/wellness)
- The Shift Network (various teachers, mixed quality)
- Teachable-hosted courses from individual practitioners

**Things to evaluate:**
- Does the teacher have actual credentials or just charisma? (Psychology background, meditation training, etc.)
- Are reviews specific about what you'll learn, not just "life-changing"?
- Does the approach match what you want—Jungian psychology, meditation-based, therapeutic, etc.?
- Free trials or money-back guarantees reduce risk

**Honest caveats:**
- "Shadow work" isn't a regulated term, so quality varies wildly
- Some courses oversell transformation
- Books (Pema Chödrön, Robert Moore, Debbie Ford) might be better starting points than courses
- Working with an actual therapist beats most online courses for deep personal work

What draws you to shadow work specifically? That might help narrow down what would actually serve you.
